release_notes:
• Nexus SR now starts in seconds instead of minutes, and the launch window shows a real progress bar while it works.
  • Closing the browser tab no longer throws the app away: reopen it within a couple of minutes and it comes back instantly. The waiting time is adjustable in Settings.
  • The app reopens on the tab and project you were last working on.
  • New GRADE module: rate the certainty of the evidence for each outcome, with the reasons recorded.
  • Study Protocol now holds structured variables, and connects to randomisation and reporting checklists.
  • Project overview shows the seven phases of a review with their real state, not a generic list.
  • Citation Chaser clears a previous run properly and stops retrying references that cannot be found.
  • Your projects, PDFs and licence now live in a single user folder, so updates never touch them.
  • An expired licence no longer closes the app: it switches to read-only, so your work is still there to read and export.
